messages:
sam.g: Heads up — NovaCore preview kickoff. NDA signed, vendor okayed limited logs. Need a rapid probe plan: latency + memory footprint + kv-cache behavior within 2 weeks. @elaine_p can you lead telemetry? @kai can you own the bench harness and lab turns?

elaine_p: On it. I'll sketch telemetry events and retention rules. Quick Q: any PII/traceback guardrails we need baked into agents? :shield:

kai: I'll spin up a sandbox VM. Need the NovaCore runtime image and model artifacts. Also what model variants are we testing (quantized vs fp16)?

sam.g: NovaCore agreed to Llama2-70b (fp16) and a 70b-8bit quantized build. They provided build artifacts and an access key in the vendor portal (link). NDA restricts raw logs; we can share aggregated metrics only.

benji: I'll take bench scripts. Proposal quick runner: `./run_bench --models 'llama2-70b,70b-8bit' --seq 2048 --batch 1` and capture p50/p95/p99 + mem.

maria_ops: Ops note — reserved lab slots 2026-03-04 -> 2026-03-10, hardware in transit. Need shipping address confirmation and phone for NovaCore freight.

partnerships-bot: Reminder: NDA expiry date 2026-08-02 (90 days left).

elaine_p: Draft telemetry proto will include: token_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit, memory_peak_mb, oom_count, kernel_events. I'll publish to repo `github.com/redwood/partnerships/nova-telemetry` and link the payload examples.

kai: Please include NVTX markers and CUDA kernel timing — that's critical for root-cause on perf spikes. Will need vendor hw token to pull low-level traces. @sam.g can you request that from NovaCore?

sam.g: Requesting token now from vendor contact (cc: legal for NDA confirmation). Also want a marketplace packaging checklist so we can prep sample container and inference.yml for the marketplace listing. @maria_ops can you own packaging constraints?

maria_ops: Packaging constraints: max image size 12GB, base runtime `ubuntu:22.04`, ENV flags `REDWOOD_PRIVACY=1`, KMS off by default. No persistent host mounts. I'll post a checklist in the repo.

benji: Bench measurement plan (high level): p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec throughput, memory peak, cost-estimate per 1k tokens. I'll open a PR with baseline numbers after smoke run.

kai: I'll add kv_cache stress tests and a hotspot prefix workload. Also propose two sweep profiles: small-batch low-latency and bulk throughput.

sam.g: Timeline: smoke run this week (quick sanity), full sweep next week. If smoke uncovers infra blockers we fall back to 8-bit-only runs to unblock partner review. :calendar:

elaine_p: Also preparing a 30-prompt quality suite (multi-domain). Reminder: quality metrics are aggregated only per NDA — no verbatim outputs published.

maria_ops: Logistics — NovaCore shipment ETA 48hrs after I confirm address. Send contact phone and preferred delivery window.

benji: Starting `bench/README.md` now. Quick usage example for the bench runner:```
./bench_runner \n  --model-path /mnt/nova/models/llama2-70b \n  --sequence-length 1024 \n  --quantization 8bit \n  --output metrics.json
```

kai: If anyone needs the Nova SDK or access token DM me; I have a short-lived token for pulls.

sam.g: Great work — I'll capture action items in the partners doc and loop in legal for the NDA clarifications. Ping if blocked. :rocket:
